brief.headline: Sentinel Spotter shipped — look at a device you own, get its identity, real risk, and a fix list. AEGIS battle sim overhaul landed.

items.text: Shipped Spotter (PR #5): glasses-native device intelligence. Fuses what you see with passive network signals into a confidence-scored identity — a single sensor can never confirm one — then scores risk by real exposure rather than raw CVSS and emits a ranked plain-language fix list. 42 tests; build/vet/race/lint green.

Spotter closes a verified authz gap: Policy.Authorize skips Scope.Decide for passive actions, so a deny-listed device was still assessable. ScopeGuard applies scope to every Spotter action and normalizes MAC separator forms (AA-BB-CC vs aa:bb:cc silently failed to match, and --scope documents accepting a BSSID).

Built the Spotter glasses HUD concept (spotter/index.html) — renders the exact `sentinel spot --format hud` JSON, walks confirmed / LAN-only / conflicting-evidence / not-mine / unrecognized states, with voice and progressive disclosure.

AEGIS battle sim: BATTLE button deploys two 24-unit combined-arms forces (Abrams, Bradley, Stryker, Humvee, Paladin, HIMARS, Apache, rifle squads) that acquire, close and engage on published effective ranges. Belt-fed weapons fire 6-9 round bursts and pause; rifles are aimed semi-auto. Armour is checked against each weapon's AP value. Faction rings, tracers, muzzle flashes, live force-strength HUD.

AEGIS military models authored in real metres with one conversion, so soldier/Humvee/Abrams proportions are correct by construction. Includes sloped Abrams glacis and 5.3m gun, Bradley TOW box, M109 fume extractor, Stryker 2+2 axle grouping and slat armour, Apache tandem cockpit. Infantry in standing/kneeling/prone with helmet, plate carrier, ruck and rifle. Houses gained gable roofs, doors, window bays and chimneys.

Fixed a latent bug that had been silently deleting model detail project-wide: mergeParts sized its buffers from the INDEXED vertex count before de-indexing, so overflow writes were swallowed and trailing parts vanished. The Stryker and Humvee were losing their entire hulls. Vertex counts roughly doubled after the fix.

AEGIS worldwide: 51 destinations across all 7 regions, each built from real coordinates and a real ETOPO1 elevation grid fetched at build time and baked in, so it still runs air-gapped. Searchable theater console (G) loads any site in ~2s.

AEGIS city identity: 8 street-grid archetypes with real bearings (Manhattan 29 deg, Barcelona 45 deg) and the empirical GHSL height gradient, so Paris reads as a 22m cap, Hong Kong a 96m wall and Dubai an 11m villa carpet with an 828m needle.

priorities.label: SENTINEL DEVELOPMENT
priorities.next: Spotter v1 merged-ready. v2 (your steer): one authorized unicast probe to corroborate identity + read firmware, gated through authz and written to the audit chain.

tasks.title: Sentinel PR #5 — review + merge Spotter
tasks.note: Device identification, exposure-aware risk, remediation ranking, HUD contract, authz guard. 42 tests green.

tasks.title: Spotter v2 — authorized network corroboration
tasks.note: One unicast probe to confirm identity and read firmware; active, scope-gated, audit-logged.

tasks.title: Sentinel: audit-chain tamper tests
tasks.note: Proposed next milestone — verify the hash-chained audit log rejects reordered/edited/truncated events.

tasks.title: Sentinel: central authorization-contract fuzzing
tasks.note: Fuzz Scope.Decide / Policy.Authorize for scope-bypass regressions.

tasks.title: AEGIS: record cinematic capture for the pitch
tasks.note: ?autodemo runs the scripted loop (~3 min): strike, 4-target salvo, airdrop, team insert + sweep + waypoint move, UCAV. Press the button again to stop.

tasks.title: Configure ElevenLabs key for authentic JARVIS voice
tasks.note: Settings panel → key + voice ID. Falls back to en-GB system voice.

tasks.title: Fill in values.md + business.md knowledge base
tasks.note: jarvis/knowledge/ — the team checks decisions against it; blanks force escalations.

roadblocks.title: Sentinel next milestone needs direction
roadblocks.impact: The team can keep hardening autonomously, but a named milestone focuses P0.
roadblocks.proposed: Approve the proposed track — audit-chain tamper tests + authorization-contract fuzzing — or name your own.

roadblocks.title: No ElevenLabs credentials
roadblocks.impact: JARVIS speaks with the system en-GB voice instead of the cinematic one.
roadblocks.proposed: Paste key + voice ID in Settings (stored in this browser only).

roadblocks.title: Knowledge base is placeholder-only
roadblocks.impact: Decisions that aren't covered by values.md get escalated instead of resolved.
roadblocks.proposed: Fill in jarvis/knowledge/values.md and business.md when you have a moment.
